$code..write: auth != null && $code.matches(/^[A-HJ-NP-Z2-9]{6}$/) && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('players/p0').val() === auth.uid) || data.child('players/p0').val() === auth.uid || data.child('players/p1').val() === auth.uid || (data.child('phase').val() === 'waiting' && !data.child('players/p1').exists() && newData.child('players/p1').val() === auth.uid))

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['name','wins','losses','draws','points']) && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 20 && newData.child('wins').isNumber() && newData.child('losses').isNumber() && newData.child('draws').isNumber() && newData.child('points').isNumber()
